breakdown.description: The setup uses C3D20R elements, but the deck uses CAX8R elements.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradiction between the case description/input deck (using CAX8R elements) and a separate instruction (to use C3D20R elements). The agent correctly resolved this by instructing to create the file 'containing exactly the input deck provided in the prompt', thus ignoring the contradictory instruction. This aligns with the ground truth, which prioritizes the provided input deck.
